name: i18n-lsp
description: Inline translation previews via inlay hints for i18n keys

i18n-lsp.serverPath.description: Path to an i18n-lsp binary to use instead of the server bundled with the extension.

i18n-lsp.translationFiles.markdownDescription: Pattern(s) for translation files, e.g. `src/locales/{locale}.json`. Leave unset to detect them automatically. A `.i18n-lsp.json` in the project overrides these settings.

i18n-lsp.defaultLocale.description: Primary locale shown first in hints. Detected when unset.

i18n-lsp.defaultNamespace.markdownDescription: Namespace for unprefixed keys when `{namespace}` is used. Detected when unset.

i18n-lsp.functionPatterns.markdownDescription: Function call patterns to detect, e.g. `["t(", "$t("]`.

i18n-lsp.keyStyle.description: How new keys are written. Detected when unset.

i18n-lsp.maxInlayLength.description: Max characters of an inlay hint before truncation.

i18n-lsp.reportUnusedKeys.description: Fade out translation keys no source file uses.
